shortDescription: Dan Eberhart is a former chief executive of oil-field services firm Canary. "Trump's Oil Allies See Nightmare Scenario of Diesel-Export Ban Becoming Reality — WSJ," at 7 a.m. ET on Sept. 23, incorrectly described him as the current CEO.
